title: Willey deserved better treatment from local police
article: A letter from Krystal Balsdon, Prince George.
"People should consider the jobs police do."

I have turned my attention to the unacceptable death of Mr. Clayton Willey because I feel that the police officers here and in surrounding areas abuse their given powers. I though they were supposed to help people, not hurt people. Just because you have been provided with a gun and a bulletproof vest doesn't mean that you have the right to do whatever you please.

The fact that Clayton Willey did drugs and sold cocaine doesn't excuse the police for his death. And if the autopsy comes back that tasering wasn't the cause of death, I'm sure it was a major helping factor as will be the undeniable beating that Mr. Willey received from the police officers on call, before being arrested.
As far as I'm concerned the friends and family members have the right to protest in the middle of the street if they choose.
